warnings.detail: stock ArduPilot requests P 32 Hz x 27.6 ms + T 32 Hz x 27.6 ms = 1766 ms/s > 1000 ms/s [DS]; the sensor serialises conversions -> effective pressure rate ~18.1 Hz.  Not a chamber issue; the analysis uses the configured 32 Hz for the fc > 2 fs check (conservative) and the 16x comb (unchanged).  Upstream driver change would be needed to fix.

Bond number 0.017; contact-angle hysteresis (th_a 110 / th_r 90 deg) pins a slug with 281 Pa vs at most 35 Pa gravity head over the full 3.2 mm height -> water that gets past a breached membrane stays and blocks the vent (secondary hydrophobic entry pressure only 281 Pa).  Breached membrane = replace cap; the membrane (W1/W4) is the water barrier.
